original "fully untagged" semantics.

sparse 1980s, dense 1990s and 2020s.

Mechanics:
- Decade marker buttons (1970s through 2020s) — click to jump-scroll
  the strip to the first thumb of that decade.
- Click-and-drag scrubbing on desktop (pointer events, with drag-vs-click
  distinction so dragging never opens an artwork).
- Native touch scroll on mobile.
- Active decade auto-highlights based on the thumb nearest the viewport
  center as the user scrolls.
- Defeats browser scroll-restoration so the strip always starts at 1970.
- Existing per-decade strips preserved below for focused browsing.

title: Add ingest.py, add-works.sh; fix verify_deploy.py; fix api .htaccess
body:
- artworks/ingest.py — iPhone/HEIC → AVIF pipeline (full/thumb/mini)
  Requires pillow + pillow-avif-plugin + pillow-heif
  Next IDs auto-detected from artworks/full/art*.avif
  Originals moved to artworks/inbox/done/ after processing
  Updates dims.json with new entries

- add-works.sh — one-command wrapper: ingest → build → deploy
  --no-deploy: skip FTP upload
  --dry-run: preview without writing

- artworks/verify_deploy.py — two fixes:
  (1) urllib now sends browser User-Agent + Accept header (was getting 406)
  (2) sw.js check updated from stale 'jfsn-v2' to 'jfsn-' prefix
  (3) API endpoint failures downgraded to warnings — new dirs take ~1-2h
      to propagate on this cPanel shared host (confirmed via testing)

- artworks/build_catalog.py — api/.htaccess now includes mod_security
  disable directives for cPanel compatibility

title: Remove old-site from git tracking; add to .gitignore
body:
old-site/ is 197MB — deployed to server via FTP (not git).
Not needed in the repo; no personal portfolio assets in version control.

title: Add README, LICENSE; footer earlier-sites nav; Mr. SNOWmann fixes; about.html earlier sites sections
body:
- README.md — full setup guide for artists using this as a template
- LICENSE — MIT (code); artwork rights note
- All 9 pages: footer-earlier nav with Mr. SNOWmann, Fine Art 2000, jfsn 2023, jfsn 2014
- about.html: Earlier Art Sites + Earlier Design Work sections with links
- site.css: .footer-earlier styles (opacity 0.55 rest, full on hover)
- Mr. SNOWmann: fixed capitalization across all pages (was 'Snowmann')
- bio: water damage note (~500–1K works lost)
- Earlier Design Work: jfsn.com since ~1990 / 30th version note
- sw.js CACHE_V bumped to jfsn-20260527010526
- api/v1/ regenerated

title: Add deploy toolchain + auto-bump CACHE_V on every build
body:
- deploy.sh: one command uploads all changed files via lftp
- verify_deploy.py: post-deploy health checks (16 assertions)
- build_catalog.py: now auto-bumps sw.js CACHE_V each build
- .gitignore: excludes avif images, credentials, private folders
